trustBoundary: Executes canonical Range compiler sources and emits nothing. Every artifact is produced by the interpreted Range compiler through Range-authored ProgramGraph lowering, ARM64 encoding, Mach-O generation, linking and signing.
invocation: explicit request only; never the public range command, package commands, build tools or distribution launchers
stage: parser plus bounded evaluator slice; canonical ARM64 instruction encoding executes; full compiler and native self-hosting not yet executed
parsedInFull: macro parameters, defaults, target and result types, and bodies
switch with relational and case patterns
explicit let/binding inputs with one name, also used as the function argument label
let-only generic members on constructs, functions and macros; named generic arguments, nested specializations and explicit empty-call distinction

retainedOpaquely.handling: source span retained verbatim; never interpreted, executed or rewritten
retainedOpaquely.justification: declares surface grammar rather than executable code
retainedOpaquely.evaluatorContract: requiring one at run time must fail loudly, never be skipped

notSupported: full compiler execution and Generation One production
macro execution, environment emission, closures and syntax-template execution
optional and union value execution, decimal/version literal execution
externs beyond the three listed and pinned bindings
full-language typing, ownership analysis and native/interpreter equivalence
generic specialization execution and type resolution; specialized union type parsing

executionContract.identity: monotonic interpreter heap handles; aggregate assignment and calls retain identity; scalars copy by value
executionContract.storage: host RawBuffer stores indexes into a 64-bit-capable interpreter value arena; no pointer or Int narrowing
executionContract.destruction: collection destruction invalidates its handle; all subsequent use including repeated destruction fails with a source location; physical interpreter arena reclaimed after execution
executionContract.resolution: reachable functions and every branch bound before execution by declaration identity, receiver type, labels and arity; ambiguous and missing targets fail before effects
executionContract.strings: canonical String declaration and Range-authored methods; literals and interpolation materialize Byte collections; embedded NUL and long strings preserved
executionContract.primitives: bounded intrinsic Int64, Byte8, Bool and String literal construction; Int/Byte bits-labeled construction converts the scalar value
executionContract.annotations: @many supplies storage cardinality; Int/Byte @integer and Bool @bool identify intrinsic representations; entered functions/types with other required annotations fail; no macro bodies are silently skipped
executionContract.limits: 100 million evaluator steps, 512 runtime call frames; full compiler performance unmeasured
